name: SettlementAuthorityTracker
tagline: Settlement negotiations, delegated authority, releases and payments – in one Power Platform app.
description: A complete litigation settlement app for in-house legal, claims and insurance teams: record every demand and offer with a negotiation bracket chart, request settlement authority with a generated memo, approve it against a delegation-of-authority matrix with segregation of duties, keep offers inside valid authority, and close only when the release is signed and the payment is made.
features: Delegation-of-authority matrix (Level=limit pairs) with required level per amount
Offers blocked above or without valid authority
Authority expiry, extension and withdrawal with undo
Segregation of duties – the handler cannot approve their own authority
Reserve cap with confirmed reserve increase
Negotiation bracket chart and authority gauge
Authority and payment memo texts for Outlook or flows
Multi-currency with reporting currency and FX rates
Bulk handler change, CSV export, undo
Phone layout with bottom navigation (375/360/320 px)
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform libraries, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (SettlementAuthorityTracker data-set control + SettlementAuthorityTrackerPortal field control)
